newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil peasants were executed by farmhands - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil peasants were executed by farmhands - report.

text.p: Three landless peasants gunned down by farmhands in Amazonian Brazil were shot at close range at least 15 times, newspapers reported on Thursday.
O Globo daily, citing an autopsy by coroners investigating the killings near the town of Ourilandia do Norte in the state of Para, said it was clear the victims had been executed.

The murders, which occurred on Monday, were the latest in a series of bloody clashes that have swept Brazil's countryside as the dispossessed battle estate owners for a share of Latin America's largest country.
The coroners investigating the Ourilandia deaths could not be reached through the sole public telephone in the town, some 435 miles (700 km) from Para state capital Belem.
